name: ConEmu
description: WinInet with IGNORE_CERT_CN/DATE_INVALID (weakened TLS); CRC32-only from that channel; executes via a generated .cmd on exit. [Opus-verified: CONFIRMED-D]
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The updater downloads a package, checks manifest-provided size/CRC, and creates a batch file for the update; HTTPS requests explicitly ignore certificate-name and date errors. The control is weakened transport plus same-channel CRC.
limitations: Review is limited to the retained commit; it does not certify released artifacts or current upstream behavior.

original_evidence.text: | ConEmu | https://github.com/Maximus5/ConEmu | native C++ Win32 | Y | chk (hourly automatic background check) / dl+inst gated by user-confirmation dialogs (ConfirmDownload, ConfirmUpdate); choosing "Yes" triggers automatic download-then-install on exit | Y — downloads installer/archive package to a temp file and writes/runs `ConEmuUpdate.cmd`, which executes the downloaded setup package on application exit | https declared (default `https://conemu.github.io/version.ini`, user-overridable via `-UpdateSrcSet`), but certificate validation is explicitly weakened: `INTERNET_FLAG_IGNORE_CERT_CN_INVALID \| INTERNET_FLAG_IGNORE_CERT_DATE_INVALID` set on every HTTPS WinInet request (hostname/CN mismatch and cert-expiry/not-yet-valid checks are both disabled) | N (version.ini is a plain-text manifest fetched over the same weakened-TLS channel; not independently signed) | hash-from-manifest (CRC32 + exact byte size, both parsed out of the same version.ini that named the download URL — not a cryptographic signature, and sourced from the same channel being verified) | N/A — no key; CRC32 expected value comes from the manifest itself, not an out-of-band trust anchor | src/ConEmu/UpdateSet.cpp:41-56 (default update-info URL, https); src/ConEmu/Update.cpp:667-750 (parses `nSrcLen`/`nSrcCRC` from version.ini); src/ConEmu/Update.cpp:779-856 (downloads package, verifies size+CRC32, confirmation prompts, retry loop); src/ConEmu/Update.cpp:1110-1135 (`CreateBatchFile` writes ConEmuUpdate.cmd that runs the installer); src/ConEmuC/Downloader.cpp:1095-1096 (`INTERNET_FLAG_IGNORE_CERT_CN_INVALID \| INTERNET_FLAG_IGNORE_CERT_DATE_INVALID` passed to `HttpOpenRequestW`) |
